name: io.github.PILOTAAI/slotlock
title: Slotlock
description: Calendars for AI agents: free/busy, next free slot, and bookings PostgreSQL never double-books.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: The bearer token the server was started with (SLOTLOCK_AUTH_TOKEN).

SLOTLOCK_AUTH_TOKEN.description: The same value as the SLOTLOCK_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the server on this machine's loopback interface only.

PORT.description: The same value as the PORT environment variable.

packageArguments.description: Serve MCP and A2A over HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: postgres:// URL of a PostgreSQL 16 database the container can reach. Without SLOTLOCK_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL this role also applies the schema, so it must be able to create it.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token MCP and A2A clients must send: at least 32 random characters (openssl rand -hex 32).

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_CONFIRMATION_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Signs pending write confirmations: at least 32 random characters, different from the token. Not needed when SLOTLOCK_CONFIRM_WRITES is none.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the server listens on inside the container.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: postgres:// URL of the schema owner. When set, migration runs as this role and grants the DATABASE_URL role only what it needs at runtime.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_CONFIRM_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Writes that wait for a person to confirm them: all, none, or a comma-separated list of slotlock_create_event, slotlock_update_event, slotlock_delete_event. Clients without MCP 2026-07-28 form elicitation have guarded writes refused.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_AVAILABILITY
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of weekly bookable-hours rules, e.g. [{"rrule":"FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR","startMinutes":540,"durationMinutes":480}]. Without rules no slot is ever offered.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: The tenant every request acts in.
